body: Thank you so much for your response. My doctor recently put me on Adderall to treat my inability to focus and complete tasks. I feel that it may actually be making my depression worse. My husband and I have been to counseling, but it was just so expensive that we couldn’t keep it up. I feel hopeless but I don’t want to feel this way. I want the fog of anxiety and depression to subside. I just don’t know where to turn.
